notes.title: Yooka-Replaylee launches on October 9!
notes.notes: [p]Hi folks! You heard that right! The news is finally out there: Yooka-Replaylee is launching on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S [b]AND[/b] Nintendo Switch 2 on [b]October 9th[/b]![/p][p]More than just a fresh coat of paint, Yooka-Replaylee will deliver the reimagined story of the beloved buddy-duo's first adventure as told from the perspective of our two heroes. Every move, mechanic and moment in the game has been carefully redesigned to elevate what fans loved the first time around, while making the experience more modern, more welcoming, and more joyful for today’s players. Yooka-Replaylee doubles the content of the original game, offering brand-new characters, collectibles, challenges, features and more. Get ready to undertake Rextro's isometric platforming challenges, customise your buddy-duo and gameplay experience with Tonics, and discover the new tactics needed to defeat each boss.[/p][p]Check out the brand-spanking-new release date announcement trailer below. The legend himself, Chris Sutherland, returned to the recording booth for this one. Start the timer! It's almost Replaylee time! [/p][previewyoutube="T1As5O96S4Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you haven't yet wishlisted Yooka-Replaylee, doing so helps us go against the almighty Steam algorithm and spread the good word of Yooka-Replaylee to all of Steam![/p][h3][b]Owner's discount confirmed![/b][/h3][p]When Yooka-Replaylee was first announced, we made a commitment to offer owners of the original Yooka-Laylee a discount on their Yooka-Replaylee purchase. We're now happy to confirm that this discount is going to be [b]-30%[/b] across all platforms![/p][p]Yooka-Replaylee will launch at [b]$29.99/£24.99/28.99€[/b] or your local equivalent (standard pricing excluding owner's and launch discount)![/p][h3][b]Retail preorders live now![/b][/h3][p]In addition to its digital launch, Yooka-Replaylee will get physical retail launches on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and the preorders for the physical release are already going live across the world! Not all retailers have gone live at the time of the announcement but we can confirm that the retail release is not exclusive to North America, so please be patient with us. Follow [url="https://www.pm-studios.com/"]PM Studios[/url] for updates on when retailers are going live![/p]

notes.title: Dev Update: We're Getting There!
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks![/p][p]It's BEEn a while! We wanted to share a quick update on the development progress of Yooka-Replaylee and what exactly you can expect from the full launch. We know you are eagerly waiting for the release date announcement and on that front the most we can share right now is: [i]soon[/i].[/p][h3][b]Current Development Progress[/b][/h3][p]The Playtonic team are busy bees (pun intended) at the moment, QA'ing the game, discovering and fixing bugs, polishing things up and optimising the game to prep it for the upcoming platform submissions. We have some ways to go still but you will be pleased to hear that the game is content complete which means all the content we're planning to have in the game for launch is now in the game and boy is there a lot of it! [i]Speaking of[/i]...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049132/9d5d8725195960fe7974970ded260ed71e7990d7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Why is it taking so long?[/b][/h3][p]Reimagining Yooka-Replaylee has been a true labor of love - one that goes far beyond a simple upgrade. We've rebuilt and expanded the game from the ground up - building out the world with all-new content, tighter controls and mechanics and fresh surprises around every corner. We've enhanced the experience in ways we only dreamed of back in 2017. This IS the Yooka-Laylee we always wanted to make - finally brought to life with everything we've learned and everything you all have asked for. If you love the original, or missed it the first time, this is the one to play. [/p][p]Here's a recap of just some of the new things you can expect from Yooka-Replaylee at launch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Refined story –[/b] You will now experience the backstory of the beloved buddy-duo and how they find themselves in the adventure of the lifetime, gathering Pagies across all the storybook worlds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rextro's Arcade –[/b] The old minigames are no more! Instead you'll jump into the feet(?), paws(?) of Rextro the dinosaur and undertake brand-new isometric platforming challenges for collectible rewards. [i]And speaking of collectibles[/i]...[/p][/*][*][p][b]New and More Collectibles –[/b] Yooka-Replaylee offers more than double the number of [b]Pagies[/b] for players to discover, upping the number of 145 in the original game to 300 in Yooka-Replaylee. And that's not all! [b]Quills[/b] now come in different colours and act as level-specific collectibles with more meaningful placements. The game also introduces two new collectibles in the forms of the [b]Pagie Puzzle Pieces[/b] and [b]Q.U.I.D.S[/b] with the latter being used to purchase tonics, cosmetics and hints for Pagie locations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tonics and Cosmetics –[/b] Tonics make their return offering old and new ways to either modify your gameplay or add a filter over your game. You'll also be able to dress up Yooka and Laylee in a large number of cosmetics![/p][/*][*][p][b]Tracking and Navigation –[/b] Yooka-Replaylee introduces a brand-new map and collectibles tracker, making it easier for you to traverse the environments, track NPC and Pagie locations along with tracking their progress. We're also introducing a new character in the form of (book)Mark who acts as your warp point and guide in Yooka-Replaylee.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenges and Secrets – [/b]The number of different puzzle and platforming challenges is double that of Yooka-Laylee! There are loads of completely new secrets to uncover.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bosses and New Enemies – [/b]All the bosses have been completely overhauled with new tactics required to defeat them! We have also entirely rebuilt all original enemies and introduced many new enemy types and variations![/p][/*][/list][p]All of this is topped off by gameplay and art overhauls make Yooka-Replaylee the ultimate way to experience the buddy-duo's very first adventure![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049132/0eebf1593954552da9bb48fcd6db883ee907bdb7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Demo Issues[/b][/h3][p]We've heard your feedback regarding the limited time PC demo that was available during Steam Next Fest in June and the performance issues people were encountering. Rest assured our team has been hard at work further optimising and improving the performance of Yooka-Replaylee with performance testing taking place on a wider set of PCs with different specs. We also want to assure that while the Steam Next Fest demo was not optimised to run on the Steam Deck, the full release is going to run on the system. [i]Wahoo![/i][/p][p][i]Yooka-Replaylee will launch on PC and consoles later this year![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049132/b70617e733468385ff7ea57e4f7a046126518862.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: It's here! The demo BEEmiere!

We will have news for you in due course![/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="YU0no9cdlyk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][u][i][b]What's new in the demo?[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p][/p][p]With approximately 30mins of playable content, the Yooka-Replaylee demo offers players a look at the completely redone start to the game, including brand-new cutscenes! The demo will take players through the sliding doors of the Hivory Towers and all the way until they are about to enter their first Grand Tome. Players will also get a taste of the new Rextro’s Arcade. Save data from the demo will transfer onto the full game at launch.  [/p][p][/p][p]And don't forget to wishlist! notes.title: New Yooka-Replaylee Gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

Yooka-Replaylee is shaping up to be a beautiful, joyful love letter to the 3D platforming genre. Don't just take my word for it, watch this video and... well, I narrated it, so take my word for it...

[previewyoutube=0l7XD9vH6lU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]So what IS Yooka-Replaylee?[/h3]

Remastered, remade, remixed, this is the definitive version of Yooka-Laylee! With shiny, new 4K graphics and visual effects, a brand-new control scheme, entirely new moves and the ability to swiftly chain moves together, it's a quicker, slicker platforming experience.

Yooka-Replaylee builds on our nearing 10 years of growth and experience since making Yooka-Laylee, as well as taking on board a whole bunch of community feedback over the years, it's jam-packed with brand new content that we think platforming fans new and old will love!

Each world in Yooka-Replaylee has been expanded by default, no longer requiring players to do that themselves, giving us the opportunity to fill each world with new challenges, new collectibles, and new THINGS added to every corner!

[h3]Quills![/h3]

Quills have new purpose in Yooka-Replaylee! Now, each world has its own Quill colour, [i]and with all of Yooka & Laylee's abilities now unlocked from the start[/i], Trowzer has had to up his game and provide some new goodies! Quills can be traded to Trowzer for things like level exclusive cosmetic items and health/energy upgrades!

[h3]Pagies![/h3]

Pagies are your pathway to new worlds! And there's new exciting ways to collect them in each world too! Pagies will give you the option to unlock new worlds when you gather enough of them, so make sure you're checking every nook and cranny for a potential Pagie challenge!

[h3]Q.U.I.D.S![/h3]

And while we're on the subject of challenges! Coinelius is the new ghostly piggy bank character that offers a variety of opportunities to perform platforming prowess in exchange Q.U.I.D.S! These shiny golden coins are dotted around every level, the more you save up, the more you can spend at Vendi! Vendi has a whoooole bunch of Tonics for sale, ranging from cosmetics, to cool new screen visual effects, new abilities like coin magnetisation, gameplay modifiers if you fancy more of a challenge and even things like a super hero landing for Yooka! You can mix and match these Tonics to create your own platforming playstyle!

There's some other colours of Q.U.I.D.S challenges spread across each world too! Look out for Red and Green coins to see what they throw at you!

We're really excited about Q.U.I.D.S! They may look like simple, static coins floating in the world, but keep an eye on them becuase there may be a few to throw you off... Okay, there definitely is... look out for Q.U.I.D.S that avoid you, chase you, and more! 

This is just a small handful of the changes we've made, we've also recently announced that Rextro has got entirely new Rextro's Arcade levels! It's safe to say there's really no area of the game we haven't looked at through a fresh lens to try and improve things!

Yooka-Replaylee is our love letter TO our love letter to classic 3D platformers and we know you're gonna love it! Stay tuned for a 2025 release date!

notes.title: Yooka-Replaylee 2024 Roundup!
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

As we approach the end of the year, I figured I'd collate a bunch of stuff into one place in case you're just joining us or may have missed things!

In June, we announced Yooka-Replaylee was coming! Our remastered/remixed version of Yooka-Laylee! The goal was to go back over the first game, as there was lots of very valid critiques and feedback, both internally and externally, and to try and make it the game we feel it should have been from the start! Having the lovely knock-on effect of setting our bigger teams up with even more knowledge and experience for future projects!

[previewyoutube=hrXXbkP5HAc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a list of just some of the things we're doing to make Yooka-Replaylee a more comprehensive experience:

[list]
[*] Revised controls! Tweaks have been made to abilities to chain together, make everything feel tighter
[*] A new camera! No more getting lost behind objects!
[*] Obviously, shinier graphics! New character renders and stuff like improved world lighting, reactive snow, grass, water etc to make the worlds feel more alive
[*] Revised Quill locations to aid better/more worthwhile exploration
[*] An entirely new collectible coin to spend at Vendi, and elsewhere!
[*] Other yet to be revealed collectibles!
[*] New characters, such as Mark a bookmark who’ll help you warp around worlds, saving the need to constantly run around, and Coinelius, a ghostly piggy bank!
[*] A world map and challenge tracker to aid exploration and completion
[*] Always expanded levels
[*] All moves unlocked from the start
[*] New and revised challenges
[*] New and improved minion/enemy variety
[*] An orchestral soundtrack
[*] Probably a bunch of other stuff I forget right now or we haven’t announced just yet!
[/list]

We've also held two Q&A/interview style videos, both of which can be found below! We'll have more videos with devs coming soon, too!

[previewyoutube=cZP-y0rkc78;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=W6Kgv7wOsNg;full][/previewyoutube]

We then also confirmed that Yooka-Replaylee will be coming to PS5, Xbox Series consoles and... Nintendo!

[previewyoutube=AGfmssnKf1s;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer teased some more gameplay footage, while we also confirmed that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2448020/view/4368013560353750550?l=english]Steam owners of Yooka-Laylee with get a discount for Replaylee[/url], as well as confirming that we're working to ensure we can offer the same to console owners when we announced the console versions!

In October, we brought the game to EGX for the public to play an early demo of Glitterglaze Glacier! You can watch a side-by-side comparison of new and old below!

[previewyoutube=NavOiYwfE0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Things have already moved on quite far since this demo in a short amount of time! We've heard some of your feedback about things like the text boxes, and lighting on this level, and we're exploring options around those topics, so stay tuned!

Speaking of the demo, I also sat down with Gavin Price, studio head and game director on Yooka-Replaylee to go into a little more detail about the changes we've already made since the demo, and teasers of some things we're still yet to show, take a look below!

[previewyoutube=9_tP6kgRV-0;full][/previewyoutube]

That's about all we've got for you this year! We'll be back in the New Year with even more Yooka-Replaylee, more gameplay, more new features and some other exciting announcements!

Let me take this opportunity to thank the community for joining us on this ride, from Playtonic as a whole and myself personally, as the community guy. I joined in January 2024 to kickstart all of our outward communications again and it has been an absolute pleasure to get to know this dedicated fanbase more intimately, to share our vision for the future with you, and to just goof around on social media. Many gaming communities are dedicated, but you folks have a passion for this lizard and bat that is often unrivalled!

Thank you again for your support <3

notes.title: Yooka-Replaylee Demo Developer Commentary!
notes.notes:
Hello fine people, platformer enjoyers and dare I say it... friends?

I come with glad tidings and a new video for you! I (Steve, hello!) sat down with Gavin Price, [strike]Supreme Glorious Leader[/strike] Game Director on Yooka-Replaylee for a bit of a chin-wag about the game, the progress we're making and some of the key differences both IN this demo that we shared with media and also some of the changes that have happened SINCE this demo was first shown!

Get this in yer eye holes:

[previewyoutube=9_tP6kgRV-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of the topics covered while I fumble around with a controller, trying to listen to my boss...

- [b]Coinelius' coins' new colour[/b] — Coinelius, the helpful piggy bank and new character edition to Yooka-Replaylee has already undergone a change with his beautiful platinum coins having stolen the golden hues of the Quill because...

- [b]Level-specific Quills[/b] — Having given up their golden coat to Coinelius' coins, Quills now come in a variety of colours as they become specific to the level the player is currently in. Why is this? Because our crafty salesman Trowzer has gotten pickier over the years.

-[b]Trowzer's new wares[/b] — The role of Trowzer is fundamentally changing in Yooka-Replaylee with a whole new set of wares to sell. What these wares are we are not ready to reveal quite yet.

- [b]All moves from the beginning[/b] — In one of the bigger changes to the game, and why the role of our beloved salesman has changed, is that players will have access to the full arsenal of Yooka and Laylee's moves from the start of the game.

- [b]New Pagie pieces collectible[/b] — A new collectible has joined the roster in the form of Pagie pieces. Collecting these will unlock additional bonuses.

- [b]Levels available in their "expanded" stage from the start[/b] — In another change to the original Yooka-Laylee, levels will now be available in their entirety from the very start. 

We'll be showing off some new content in the New Year, as well as bringing you a wrap-up of what we've revealed so far since June in the coming weeks, so stay tuned for that!

Also worth mentioning, that [b]YES[/b], we're going to discount Yooka-Replaylee if you own Yooka-Laylee [i](On Steam, and working with the console platforms to ensure this too)[/i] and YES we are still listening to your feedback on what we reveal so far, I can't promise anything as we're all very busy bees but as the Community Manager, I'm seeing your comments and feeding back everything! 

That's all for now, new friends, see you soon!

notes.title: Kickstarter Backer Credits | Name Change Update
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE: Since posting, we have removed the need to provide the elusive "BackerKit ID"[/b]

Hey folks!

When we announced Yooka-Replaylee, we had more than a handful of people ask us whether backers of the original game would still feature in the credits, and if so, would there be the possibility of changing the name featured in the credits.

I am pleased to say that the answer to both of these questions is: [i][b]Yes![/b][/i]

We are, of course, still incredibly appreciative to those of you who helped bring Yooka & Laylee into the world [strike]kicking and screaming[/strike] [i]rolling and sonar...ing[/i]? And we’re also aware of the fact that some people have since changed their given names or have perhaps since decided that “xXThaToastGhostXx” isn’t as cool as it was 10 years ago (I disagree, I think that’s a [i]sick[/i] name). If we’re remastering the game, it’s only fair you get to remaster your name!

With this in mind, [url=https://forms.gle/xB2T8ytygGEuG9Dw8]we’ve created a Google Form[/url] for folks who originally backed the game to provide us with their new, preferred name they’d like to see in the Yooka-Replaylee credits!

You will need to provide the following details, if any of these are not included or incorrect, [i]we will not be able to proceed with updating your name[/i]:

- The email address you used for BackerKit
- Your original name featured in the credits
- Your new desired name

Some general rules:

·        Please use only ASCII characters
·        You are limited to 40 characters
·        No vulgar, abusive, racist, homophobic, transphobic or otherwise offensive terms
·        No legal entity, copyright protected or trademarked names allowed
·        If you are a minor, or want to enter the name of a minor, please make sure you have the permission of parents or guardians
·        Please be aware that your name will be visible to everyone who plays the game
·        We reserve the right to remove inappropriate names
·        Please don't include URLs, twitter handles or email addresses
·        ASCII art will most likely not show up correctly, so please don't include it
·        [b]If you wish to have your name removed from the credits, please tick the check box option at the bottom of the form and enter “N/A” in the new name field.[/b]

Hopefully it goes without saying but please don't fill this form out if you weren't an original backer of Yooka-Laylee, some poor person who draws the short straw (Not me!) is going to have to manually cross-reference all of these names so please help us by only filling this out if it's relevant to you!

[url=https://forms.gle/xB2T8ytygGEuG9Dw8]REQUEST A NAME CHANGE HERE![/url]

[b]Submissions will close two weeks from now on 11/10/24 and no further changes will be accepted.[/b]

Stay tuned for more updates sooooon!

notes.title: Yooka-Replaylee FAQ
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We've put together a quick FAQ to cover some of the frequently asked questions about Yooka-Replaylee! Check it out below to see if YOUR frequently asked question has an answer!

We'll also be doing a dev Q&A soon to discuss more about the game so stay tuned for that!

[b]What is Yooka-Replaylee? Is this a remaster?[/b] 

Yooka-Replaylee is the culmination of almost 10 years of experience since we founded Playtonic way way back in 2015! We’ve taken on board all the community feedback as well as channelling everything we’ve learned while working on other projects to make this the definitive version of Yooka-Laylee. It’s more than a remaster! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448020/YookaReplaylee/]Find out more on the store page.[/url] 

Here's some videos to give you a bigger picture!

[url=https://youtu.be/cZP-y0rkc78?si=AdQ0ZhWsj21hKeoR]Yooka-Replaylee Dev Q&A[/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/W6Kgv7wOsNg?si=qFb_cqrMV8vMOTtf]Yooka-Replaylee Art Q&A[/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NavOiYwfE0Q]Yooka-Replaylee vs Yooka-Laylee Gameplay Comparison[/url]

[b]Why now? [/b]

Well, we’re approaching our 10th Birthday as a studio and as we’ve grown and learned, we’ve always wanted to revisit the game that started it all and what better way to celebrate reaching 10 years?! That’s no easy feat in the current games landscape! We’re incredibly proud of Yooka-Laylee and how it defines Playtonic but we’d be lying if we said we haven’t always wanted to go back and do things a little differently. 

[b]What else are you guys working on?[/b]

As part of the Yooka-Replaylee announcement, we’ve alluded to the fact that we’ve taken learnings from our other projects. A lot of our founding team come from an era where games are ready when they’re ready, not tied to arbitrary deadlines. We have some cool things cooking up behind the scenes that we’ll show when they’re ready to show! Yook-an rest assured that this isn’t “it”!

[b]Will original owners get a discount?[/b]

Yes! So far we've confirmed that anyone who owns the game on Steam will get a discount! Since we've announced the game is coming to PS5, Xbox Series consoles and... Nintendo platforms... we're also pleased to say we're working with platforms to ensure we can provide discounts to as many folks as possible across these platforms. We'll have more details, including the discount % as soon as we possibly can!

[b]When can we expect Yooka-Replaylee? [/b]

We’re still in development and we still have fun features to add and talk about so we’re not ready to share a release date just yet!

[b]What platforms is Yooka-Replaylee coming to? [/b]

Yooka-Replaylee will be coming to PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Nintendo platforms!

notes.title: Announcing Yooka-Replaylee!
notes.notes:
Calling all 3D platformer fans! A lizard and a bat... we are so back!
 
Hello folks!
 
[previewyoutube=hrXXbkP5HAc;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We are VERY pleased to finally show you one of the [i][b]many exciting things[/b][/i] we've been working on! Introducing Yooka-Replaylee!
 
One of the ways we wanted to celebrate our approaching [b]10th Birthday[/b] is by providing fans with the best way to play the game that started it all!
 
[i]"What a great new pun-derful title"[/i] we hear you say, but you want to know details. We've got you: There's a revised control and camera system, tweaks to abilities, remixed and new challenges, new collectibles, a fancy new coat of visual paint, of course, and more we'll be digging in to in the coming months!
 
Yooka-Replaylee is the culmination of almost 10 years of experience since founding Playtonic (Seriously, how has it been nearly 10 years since 2015?!) and we've channelled much of what we've learned while tinkering on other projects, as well as taking on board community feedback from the original release, in to making this the best way to play Yooka-Laylee.
 
Very soon, we'll be releasing a Q&A video with some developers you may recognise to talk more about what Yooka-Replaylee is and what it means for us as studio. Until then, stay tuned to our socials for more news and Wishlist Yooka-Replaylee on Steam!
